exposure: Diagnosis (Congenital pulmonary airway malformation (CPAM) vs. Bronchial atresia (BA))
outcome: Age at presentation of primary symptom
cohort: 112 patients with a pathological diagnosis of CPAM or BA
finding: CPAM and BA have distinct clinical features in terms of therapeutic and natural history, with CPAM presenting earlier and requiring more interventions, but with similar survival rates.
mod_finding: Caesarean section rates were significantly higher in patients with prenatally diagnosed CPAM compared to prenatally diagnosed BA (81% vs 9%, p < 0.0001).
